candidate_evaluation.failure_policy: preserve the candidate, record the failure, continue training, retry later on the identical pack
candidate_evaluation.hour_168_gate: every marked candidate must carry a complete 128-game result before the frozen selection rule is applied
candidate_evaluation.runs: out of band, in its own process, never inside the training loop
candidate_evaluation.selection_rule: highest equal-weight mean EWR across the four strata; tie-break on highest minimum stratum EWR; then the later candidate hour
candidate_evaluation.selection_rule_identity: highest equal-weight mean EWR across the four strata; tie-break on highest minimum stratum EWR; then the later candidate hour

deadline_semantics.derivation: run_deadline_utc = run_start_utc + 604800s, materialized exactly once at launch and persisted in every hot checkpoint
deadline_semantics.post_deadline: recovery finalizes and takes zero optimizer steps
deadline_semantics.restart: a restart reuses the persisted window; it never creates a new one
deadline_semantics.rule: run_deadline_utc = run_start_utc + 604800s, computed once and persisted; a restart never creates a fresh 168-hour duration

historical.archive: append-only; entries are never pruned for inactivity
historical.counts: exact largest-remainder partition, ties rotated by iteration
historical.membership: pure function f(k) of the ordered archive; no tournament

monitoring.committed_games: authoritative; read from rollout-store iteration manifests
monitoring.controls: emergency stop only; every frozen key is refused by name
monitoring.process_counter_games: diagnostic only; process-local and lost across a crash
monitoring.worker_health: live OS children of the learner, not a configured constant

objectives.behavior_kl: adaptive beta against the frozen behavior policy
objectives.policy: PPO clipped surrogate over advantage-filtered learner decisions
objectives.value: categorical cross-entropy over the 3-class W/D/L head, weight 0.5

purpose: the immutable configuration the 168-hour Phase 14 final training run executes. Building this document starts nothing.

recovery_semantics.no_write_during: a collection unit (297-311 s observed in the rehearsal)
recovery_semantics.read_checkpoint_age_as: up to one cadence plus a collection, not up to one cadence
recovery_semantics.what_a_crash_can_cost: un-checkpointed optimizer work, which is repeated
recovery_semantics.writes_occur_at: safe training boundaries, not on a timer interrupt

rng_semantics.evidence: Phase 13 Agent 3 collected and trained the same iteration twice under two deliberately different global torch seeds: identical games, decisions, terminal results, bucket counts, updates, examples consumed, epoch plan and final model state digest f27ea740c4f13c7e5c8576adb1a789c84061cc6777ba7661d90f311cfa9cdf60
rng_semantics.reason: logical Phase 14 randomness uses explicit deterministic streams rather than ambient global RNG

search_prohibition: search may not be used for self-play action selection, training targets, opponent policies, policy improvement or trajectory generation; Phase 14 trains the direct C1 policy/value system only

agent1c.role: belief/search pipeline only; never the Phase 14 policy/value start

starting_model.ema: absent - the accepted Phase 9 system maintains no EMA
starting_model.optimizer_state: fresh AdamW moments (zero); KL controller beta0 0.005
starting_model.role: Phase 14 starting policy/value AND belief auxiliary head

storage_policy.contingency: pre-authorized only below 120 GiB free: delete already-consumed disposable Phase 14 raw shards oldest-first, retaining all checkpoints, metrics, historical snapshots and a 1-in-16 sample of deleted shard ranges
storage_policy.no_deletion_rule: earlier accepted project evidence is never deleted under any condition, including to create storage space

supervision.candidate_evaluation: pending marks are detected from the ledger on disk and evaluated in a separate process, one at a time, with no path back into training
refuses_to_restart_when: the run manifest says training is closed
an unrecoverable integrity failure has been recorded
the deadline has passed (one zero-step closeout launch excepted)
the bounded consecutive-restart policy is exhausted

transition.rule: elapsed against the original run start; downtime counts
